tasks.task_name: Soil Moisture and Temperature Correlation Analysis
tasks.description: Analyze the relationship between soil moisture and temperature to understand their impact on crop growth.
Classify crops into different growth stages (Seedling, Vegetative, Flowering) based on sensor data.
Compute the Nutrient Balance Ratio to assess the balance between nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium in the soil.
Estimate the Photosynthesis Potential based on sunlight exposure, CO2 concentration, and temperature.
Calculate the Soil Fertility Index to assess composite soil fertility based on organic matter and NPK levels.
Analyze the efficiency of water usage per kilogram of crop yield to optimize irrigation strategies.
Compute the Temperature-Humidity Index to evaluate crop stress due to heat and moisture.
